description: Visualises a multi-phase user journey with SVG emotion curve and structured breakdown grid

attributes.name: persona
attributes.description: Persona name shown in the header

attributes.name: persona-id
attributes.description: Links the persona name to a user-persona element by id

attributes.name: story-ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated related story IDs, rendered as fragment links

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON journey record (title, persona, personaId, summary, phases). Fetched once per value; a newer value aborts the older request.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Journey heading (e.g. <h2>). Defaults to "User Journey"; also labels the phase table.

slots.name: persona
slots.description: Not projected: the text of a slot="persona" child is read as the persona name when the persona attribute is absent

events.name: user-journey:ready
events.description: Once per element, after the first render. With src, after the fetched data renders (not fired if the fetch fails). Not re-fired by later renders or moves. For the 0.3.x line the deprecated un-namespaced alias journey-ready is dispatched right after, with the same detail.

events.name: user-journey:upgraded
events.description: Once, in a microtask after first connect. Wait for this before assigning .data or .phases from a framework.

events.name: user-journey:phases-changed
events.description: After .phases is assigned a different array
